manual_trigger_only.details: Triggered via workflow_dispatch with dry_run boolean input

no_news_pipeline_coupling.details: Does not invoke agent_reach_editor.py or build_news.py

no_llm_api_calls.details: Zero Gemini or paid LLM API secrets or invocations configured

no_news_data_modification.details: Does not read, write, or touch news_data.json or index.html

no_accidental_root_publication.details: Artifact staging path is strictly dist_events/

least_privilege_permissions.details: contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write (no write permissions to repo contents)

no_secrets_exposed_in_logs.details: No secret tokens printed or echoed

failsafe_abort_on_error.details: Unit tests and isolation checks must pass before upload-artifact step executes
